[What do we do?]{.eyebrow}

## Electrons, atoms and photons — together

::: {.lead}
We develop quantum technologies that use simultaneous control over **free electrons**, **atoms** and **light**. By bringing cold atoms and nanophotonic devices into the beam of an electron microscope, we create new ways to generate, shape and measure quantum states of light and matter.
:::

## One lab

::: {.pillars}
:::: {.pillar}
[e⁻]{.letter}

### Free electrons
Electron-microscope beams shaped and modulated by light — coherent quantum probes with nanometer and femtosecond resolution.
::::
:::: {.pillar .blue}
[At]{.letter}

### Atoms
Cold atomic media and atom arrays, controlled with lasers through electromagnetically induced transparency and Rydberg interactions.
::::
:::: {.pillar}
[γ]{.letter}

### Photons
Nanophotonic and near-field light that couples electrons and atoms, for tunable quantum light sources and quantum interconnects.
::::
